content.json:
## ServiceHub export investigation
ServiceHub rows are a **synthetic fixture** (see EvidenceClass). Incidents and alerts are what Microsoft Sentinel actually created from them.

content.query:
ServiceHubAudit_CL
| where Operation == "PartsExportRead"
| extend CaseStatus = iff(isempty(CaseId), "No service case", "Service case")
| summarize Exports = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), CaseStatus
content.title: Parts exports by case status

content.query:
ServiceHubAudit_CL
| where Operation == "PartsExportRead" and isempty(CaseId)
| project TimeGenerated, Actor, ClientIp, FileName = extract(@"([^/]+)$", 1, TargetResource), EvidenceClass, FixtureId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Exports with no service case

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where RelatedAnalyticRuleIds has "__RULEID__"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Owner = tostring(Owner.assignedTo), Tags = tostring(Labels), CreatedTime, IncidentUrl
| order by CreatedTime desc
content.title: Incidents from the export rule
